description: RYOBI Introduces the ONE+ 18V Cordless 2-Tool Combo Kit with 1/2 in. Drill/Driver, 1/4 in. Impact Driver, (2) 1.5Ah Lithium-Ion Batteries, 18V Charger and Bag. ONE+ Drill/Driver delivers up to 515 in-lbs. Torque. of torque and features 1/2 in. Metal chuck with ratchet to suit your drilling and screwing needs. The ONE+ impact driver is capable of screwing long deck screws or large delay screws with ease by delivering 3,400 IPM along with 1800 in./lbs. of torque controlled by a variable speed trigger that produces 2,700 RPM. ONE+ 1.5Ah lithium-ion batteries feature a built-in high-visibility fuel gauge to monitor remaining run time. The 18V charger is compatible with RYOBI ONE+ lithium-ion batteries. Best of all, this kit is part of the RYOBI ONE+ system of over 260 tools that work on the same battery platform. Backed by the RYOBI manufacturer's 3-year warranty, the 18V ONE+ 2-in-1 Wireless Combo Kit includes (1) PCL206 18V ONE+ 1/2" Wireless. Drill/Driver, (1) PCL235 18V ONE+ Cordless 1/4 in. Impact Driver, (2) PBP002 18V 1.5Ah Lithium-Ion Batteries, (1) 18V Charger, Operator's Tool and Manuals Bag.
